Owner agent: `test-implementation-agent`

Architecture: sections 6.1/6.2/8/11/19; business derivation remains inward of adapters and Party/detail/outbox changes remain one transaction. DBML: `parties.display_name`, `natural_person_details.given_names/family_names`, `legal_entity_details.legal_name`, audit/version fields, and the normative atomicity note at DBML lines 133-145.
Inputs: completed T039 application artifacts, existing `DisplayName` domain policy and domain tests, frozen OpenAPI Party detail schemas, final DBML, and triggering implementation result `.factory/runs/oc-eb4d0fbc-78b6-4f3e-96e7-0fab5ba605b1/result.json`. Assert exact canonical values from the existing `DisplayName.forNaturalPerson` and `DisplayName.forLegalEntity` policy, including trim/collapse behavior while preserving case and diacritics; prove preferred/trade names do not replace the canonical source. Prove the canonical value and its matching source details reach one boundary-neutral Party mutation intent and one atomic Party unit-of-work call with tenant, expected version, actor, geography-before-transaction ordering and outbox identity unchanged. Cover type/detail mismatch and blank required source rejection before persistence. Do not prescribe SQL, persistence records, adapter constructors, transport DTOs, a second normalization algorithm, or a new business default.
